summary: Move VM create/update placement admission from Controller resource mirrors to the pool master, including local-storage definitions. API impact: new contract for authenticated Core placement preflight; changed definition acknowledgements and capability negotiation; public request shapes remain unchanged.

guide.reason: Creation, editing and media definition changes require upgraded selected Core and master, with asynchronous native validation and safe retry guidance.

api.reason: Documents master-to-member placement preflight, exact command and generation binding, explicit master acknowledgement, capability/version behavior and failure/retry results.

roadmap.reason: Master placement is implemented for development while native multi-host fault/recovery acceptance stays open; no phase is closed.

state.reason: The master approves and durably records VM ownership and definition revisions; Controller retains no placement authority.
state.record: Existing pool master pool-vms.json VM owner/specification and pending update records, plus selected Core managed VM journals. A replacement Controller recovers the same IDs, names and definitions through existing authenticated managed inventory from the hosts; fresh observations establish readiness.

verification.method: Full go test -race -timeout 20m ./... passed; final agent-only replay safety corrections passed a fresh go test -race ./internal/agent -count=1. API generation and 29 contract checks, two simulated-Core browser harnesses with inspected captures, worktree documentation/privacy gates and diff checks passed. Native local-master and multi-host lab acceptance remain open; see QA for precise coverage and review.
